Copies into the tone driver buffer; playback can outlive the module. Driver locking may block.

methods.getter_effects:
Every call claims the OSD display, including queries and later-rejected arguments.
The getter waits for the OSD semaphore without a timeout, before the binding lock.
Stop cannot interrupt that wait. Normal drawing resumes about two seconds after the last call.
